freely-chosen-day.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: landscape architectural story illustration for a hopeful near-future visual worldbuilding atlas. Generate exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: ONE integrated image divided into THREE equal-width vertical panels, each a full-height eye-level inhabited scene. Together they follow the SAME ordinary adult woman through a freely chosen day in a civilization with generous dependable shared provision. No text or labels anywhere; short explanatory captions will be placed outside this image.
Visual storytelling: Protagonist is a woman about 38, warm brown skin, distinctive short curly black hair, teal loose overshirt over a cream top, dark trousers, small orange fabric cross-body bag. Keep her face, hair, clothes and bag consistent across all three panels; she is large enough to identify immediately. Her material security is ordinary and welcoming, with no exclusive club or luxury-service hierarchy.
LEFT PANEL: A genuinely private quiet home, comfortable and beautiful but personal rather than hotel-like. The protagonist sits sideways at her breakfast table beside a partly open balcony door; morning breeze stirs a sheer curtain. A metal cup, fruit, an open personal book, soft chair, plants and a glimpse of green urban terraces. She is alone, resting and looking out, with no screen asking her to work. A small routine delivery compartment by the entry has ordinary fresh supplies. The closed interior door and her relaxed posture make private life palpable.
MIDDLE PANEL: At a sunlit neighborhood provision hall, the same protagonist collects a generous everyday lunch from a long accessible counter with many fresh options, while greeting an older neighbor seated comfortably with their mobility aid. Quiet purpose-built robotic arms behind the counter wash and replenish durable bowls; a small autonomous service cart moves in a separate recessed service lane. A glass-fronted calm care room and an accessible lounge are visible further back, integrated with food and shared daily services. No queue, money, ID scanner, work uniform, authorization gate, rationing or payment interface. Ordinary people feel at home.
RIGHT PANEL: In a beautiful public instrument and fabrication library, the same protagonist takes a compact portable telescope with a brass-toned barrel from a low open equipment shelf. A nearby older friend with silver hair points toward the courtyard sky; their shared interest is personally chosen. Open racks carry different well-maintained tools, reusable parts and cases; behind glazed doors a guarded robotic fabrication cell tends an instrument part. Daylight, pale mineral floors, visible reusable light steel structure, warm timber, useful furniture. No employee/client hierarchy or obligatory class.
Style: Cinematic architectural concept painting with credible human proportions, richly observed material texture, warm restrained color, realistic light, gentle lived detail; visually persuasive future one could inhabit. Advanced technology is integrated into ordinary life. Keep three spaces clearly distinct and protagonist repeated once in each. Three equally sized panels separated only by narrow clean vertical cream gutters. Uncropped full-height compositions with faces and useful physical interactions central in each panel.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, dystopia, wealth ostentation, giant crowds, surveillance interfaces, membership checks, work-performance metrics, humanoid servants attending idle elites.

changing-the-rules.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: three-scene cinematic illustrated episode in a future worldbuilding atlas. Generate exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Input image: reference image ONLY for the established shared-quest canal-city architecture, dusk lighting, realistic material texture, and the two established guild members (curly dark-haired young adult man in green cloak with clear glasses, dark-haired young adult woman in embroidered blue cloak with clear glasses). Create a completely NEW story image, not a crop or duplicate.
Primary request: ONE landscape image divided into THREE equally wide vertical panels by narrow cream gutters. Each panel is a full-height eye-level physical scene in the SAME lantern-lit canal-side guild room with a tall stone arch overlooking water, carved dark wooden beams and a long timber game table. The panels follow a small positive episode in which people learn how their game rules shape participation and change those rules together. No text, letters, numerical scores, diagrams with labels, speech bubbles or captions inside the image.
Recurring characters: The two established guild members described above; one newcomer adult with medium brown skin, long copper-brown hair braided loosely over one shoulder, simple rust-orange tunic and a light cream scarf. Keep all three recognizable in every panel, with the same clothes and faces. Everyone is respectfully portrayed and fully clothed.
LEFT PANEL: The large ornate game table has one elaborate central tower, a cluster of gleaming earned game tokens, and one impressive ship-model controlling piece, all concentrated within reach of the two established guild members. They are occupied with playing and enjoying their achievements, not villains. The newcomer stands at the far end near an unused stool, holding a single plain wooden token and watching with interest but unable to find a route into the game. The table's physical layout and closed cluster of pieces make the participation problem visible; no poverty, humiliation, violence or hostility.
MIDDLE PANEL: Same three adults now sit or lean together at that same table with open attentive expressions. The newcomer points to a new route made with a curved strip of blue cloth on a physical game map. The green-cloaked established member moves several tokens outward from the central tower toward reachable stations; the blue-cloaked member opens a hinged side of the board to make another playable route. Hands, tactile pieces and eye contact show collective authorship. The gleaming ship model remains in view, but the arrangement is changing.
RIGHT PANEL: The same newcomer is now actively shaping a new canal quest at the table, placing an imaginative small bridge model beside the blue cloth river, while BOTH established members visibly participate as companions, one trying the new route and the other welcoming another ordinary adult participant. The ship model and tower remain as familiar achievements, while many reachable entry points and shared movable pieces make the revised game legible. Small blue constellation-like AR motes above the model echo the reference's shared fantasy layer; these are subtle and do not replace physical objects.
Style: richly textured, cinematographic near-photoreal architectural concept painting; warm amber lanterns inside, cool blue canal twilight beyond the repeated stone arch. Bodily gestures and game objects clear at reading distance. About four adults maximum per panel; recurring faces large enough to recognize. Image should invite the reader into a persistent lived MMORPG culture and into the pleasure of making its conditions better.
Constraints: three equal vertical panels, same place/time vocabulary and main three characters, obvious beginning/middle/changed outcome, no generated words or numbers, no elite domination imagery or sad poor people, no screen dashboard, no magical disembodied hands. Root will supply the precise proposed rule and interpretive captions outside the image.

expressive-commons.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: immersive architectural worldbuilding illustration, landscape 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: Show a hopeful near-future expressive commons whose life centers on movement, music, sensory experience, friendship and rest. The viewer should feel physically inside the gathering, sharing its rhythm. This is a distinct way of being, with no academic lesson, work project, performance evaluation or demand to produce.
Scene: A magnificent yet intimate high-ceilinged community hall at night, with sweeping warm mineral-shell arches and curved panels of acoustically textured timber, soft pearl-grey sprung floor, subtle integrated lighting tracks and luminous hanging fabric baffles. Rich violet, amber and blue light bends softly over real surfaces. Broad steps flow into an accessible level floor. A wide dark window reveals the far lights of a inhabited city; do not fill the scene with plants or a garden aesthetic. Contemporary advanced architecture built to support sound, vibration, changing illumination and relaxed bodies; beautifully detailed but believable physical walls, surfaces and support.
Embodiment and people: Eye-level camera standing in the dance space, about one arm's reach from a smiling adult friend wearing a loose flowing terracotta shirt and trousers, reaching an open hand toward the viewer in invitation. At the extreme lower edge a single viewer's forearm/hand is visible opening toward that friend, with anatomically natural space between hands. Behind this friend, a small mixed group of fully clothed adults moves together freely in a gentle circular improvisation, no audience-stage division, no gym or exercise class. Some have closed eyes or turned bodies to feel the sound. A woman using a wheelchair participates at the circle's open edge. On a low side platform one person plays a curved wood-bodied hand percussion instrument and another plays a string instrument, integrated companions rather than celebrities on stage. The bodily atmosphere is warm, playful, fluid and emotionally expressive, not a party advertisement.
Quiet edge: Clearly visible on the right, an acoustically sheltered alcove with a curved upholstered recliner holds one adult resting alone comfortably, looking toward a small pool of warm lamp light rather than watching or serving the group. A partial curved screen creates privacy while retaining the spaciousness of the hall. Their solitude and stillness are as legitimate as the dancing.
Technology: A discreet small autonomous service cart with clean drinking vessels rests in a recessed wall bay away from the dancers. Ceiling lighting and acoustic hardware are integrated in the ribs and baffles. Technology serves the lived atmosphere without screens, dashboards or holographic clutter.
Style: highly refined near-photoreal cinematic architectural concept art with coherent bodies, natural expressions, touchable materials and carefully composed depth. Bold atmospheric light, distinct from sunlit garden or university scenes. The frame should feel lived from within, not a distant architectural overview. No labels, text, logos, watermark, nudity, sexualized costume, rank, points, prizes, compulsory happiness or officials supervising. Keep background figures limited and recognizable.
